note: AI-made proposal: the track of each title is not confirmed by the course designers.

1.name: Track 1 – Creative
1.who: Designers, product and project managers, and others with little or no coding experience. The job is deciding what the experience should be and directing the tools that build it.

2.name: Track 2 – Creative Engineer
2.who: People comfortable with both design and code. The job is designing the experience and building it.

3.name: Track 3 – Engineer
3.who: Strong programmers who add design and creative skill. The job is building the system, with design judgment as the differentiator.
